target.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget
target.body:
Related: #95750

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where a wedged main session can keep entering automatic restart recovery across gateway restarts after the durable retry budget should already be exhausted. The user-visible failure mode is a gateway restart death-loop: the same aborted main-session row can be recovered again across boots instead of being quarantined.

The source-of-truth boundary is the persisted `SessionEntry` row. Restart recovery must read the freshest file-backed retry/quarantine state before dispatching any resume work.

## Why This Change Was Made

This update keeps the durable retry/quarantine direction, but tightens the recovery boundary so the retry budget is only charged for dynamic recovery work:

- Existing transcript preflight still decides whether a transcript tail is resumable before `resumeMainSession` can dispatch.
- Non-resumable transcript tails are failed by preflight and do not consume the restart-recovery retry budget.
- Resumable transcript recovery and pending-final-delivery recovery reserve a durable attempt immediately before dispatch.
- Already exhausted rows are quarantined before transcript replay or resume dispatch.
- Old released rows without `restartRecoveryAttempts` derive a legacy budget floor from distinct `restartRecoveryRuns` markers, while keeping `restartRecoveryRuns` as lifecycle ignore markers rather than treating it as the new precise counter.

The session-store cache hardening remains part of this PR: cache identity includes nanosecond stat fields (`ctimeNs`/`mtimeNs`) plus size and millisecond fields, so fast same-size rewrites cannot leave restart recovery reading stale in-process rows.

Normal user progress clears stale automatic recovery/quarantine metadata, including the rotation case where a real user turn moves to a fresh session id. Trusted automatic restart-recovery resume turns keep their recovery state. The retry budget policy is not expanded.

Boundaries and non-goals:

- Adds optional persisted restart-recovery/quarantine fields to `SessionEntry`; existing rows do not need migration.
- Does not change credentials, auth, provider discovery, network behavior, public config defaults, wire protocol, or Telegram/systemd runtime behavior.
- Does not add a live Telegram/systemd/provider loop proof. For this issue, the fixed behavior is a file-backed recovery decision that prevents dispatch after budget exhaustion and fails non-resumable transcript tails before budget charging; the runtime proof exercises that production entrypoint directly.
- Another open candidate was visible for the same issue; this update repairs the existing contributor PR and leaves final landing-path choice to maintainers.

## User Impact

Operators get durable restart-recovery retry enforcement across gateway restarts. A main session that exhausts its recovery budget is quarantined instead of repeatedly resuming in a restart death-loop, while preflight-detected non-resumable transcript tails fail without burning the liveness retry budget.

## Evidence

Validation on the current local commit `28c37c786d16ecad51acbcfc1a90c740be7b2886` with committed code diff sha256 `d3535d950e3a20128ee4707b67a88fc07ba4d497e83a857ea9124e4224b4a38b`:

```text
Validation `review-update-20260706-final3-runtime-restart-recovery-boundary-proof` (pass, exit_code=0)
[main-session-restart-recovery] quarantined main-session restart recovery after retry budget: agent:main:main
proof exhausted-attempts: skipped=1, no resume dispatch path, durable quarantine persisted
[main-session-restart-recovery] quarantined main-session restart recovery after retry budget: agent:main:main
proof legacy-markers: old released row maps to attempts=3 and quarantines before resume dispatch
[main-session-restart-recovery] marked interrupted main session failed: agent:main:main (transcript tail is not resumable)
[main-session-restart-recovery] main-session restart recovery complete: recovered=0 failed=1 skipped=0
proof preflight: non-resumable transcript fails before resume dispatch and does not charge retry budget
runtime proof: restart-recovery budget and preflight boundaries verified on current local head
```

Focused session/restart-recovery regression coverage:

```text
Validation `review-update-20260706-final3-main-session-restart-recovery-test` (pass, exit_code=0)
Test Files 2 passed / Tests 84 passed

Validation `review-update-20260706-final3-targeted-session-recovery-tests` (pass, exit_code=0)
Test Files 6 passed / Tests 464 passed
Test Files 2 passed / Tests 58 passed
Test Files 2 passed / Tests 89 passed
[test] passed 3 Vitest shards
```

Static checks:

```text
Validation `review-update-20260706-final3-tsgo-core` (pass, exit_code=0)
Validation `review-update-20260706-final3-tsgo-core-test` (pass, exit_code=0)
Validation `review-update-20260706-final3-oxlint-core` (pass, exit_code=0)
Validation `review-update-20260706-final3-diff-check` (pass, exit_code=0)
```

Review finding disposition:

- Preflight boundary: existing preflight still blocks non-resumable transcript tails before `resumeMainSession`; this update fixes the earlier implementation issue where the durable attempt was reserved before that preflight decision.
- Old released-row shape: covered by tests and runtime proof for `abortedLastRun: true` rows with exhausted distinct `restartRecoveryRuns` markers and no `restartRecoveryAttempts`.
- `restartRecoveryRuns` semantics: kept as lifecycle ignore markers; only used as a legacy attempt floor when `restartRecoveryAttempts` is absent.
- Persisted session-state upgrade behavior: disclosed for maintainer decision. The new fields are optional and scoped to restart-recovery lifecycle decisions.
- Real behavior proof request: satisfied as issue-specific file-backed runtime proof for exhausted-budget no-dispatch and preflight no-budget-charge paths; limitation disclosed that it is not a full Telegram/systemd/live-provider loop.
